name: example-client-plugin
description: A MindRoom client plugin for the tests: renders messages that carry com.example.greeting, adds three side panels, one whose rows, menu and dialog are the app's own and which shows a greeting's text as the app renders an agent's reply, and one that draws its own frame, slides in and out as the room's panels do, and says the app's theme kind and screen size and previews a PDF, and one that shows a thread as the room's page does, a room header action, three slash commands and two room menu entries, one of them critical, a card for the links of example.org items in messages, shows a banner under the room header, whose words its build module writes in and which names the thread the room shows, covers the conversation, and opens a session on the computer of one of the room's agents.
